incidents.name: HORS LP holder missing input validation
incidents.notes: The contract holding the WBNB/HORS LP tokens exposes a function (selector 0xf78283c7) that accepts a caller-supplied router and recipient without validation, so the attacker passed its own contract and had the LP transferred out, then removed the liquidity.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x6f3390c6C200e9bE81b32110CE191a293dc0eaba created 2021-05-12T02:56:01Z by 0x6298194afa16862870521908caa7e9d138360858, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x8efb9311700439d70025d2b372fb54c61a60d5df; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 14.8 WBNB x $696.54/BNB at the incident timestamp 1736345084 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $10,309.
